title: Quick replies watch poll never ends when the shortcut id never resolves, and runs while locked
trigger: In Quick Replies add a new shortcut name, type a message and Add; the server refuses (or never reports the shortcut). Leave the box open, or lock the app.
effect: quick_replies_pump returns false at `let Some(shortcut_id) = resolved else { return false }`, so the 200 ms watch task loops until the box is closed, also behind the lock screen (no refused_while_locked check). Wasted wakeups; no redraw.
fix: Watch stage in the dialog (Idle/Waiting{since}) that ends on settle or refusal; or stop the poll when the save is answered with no shortcut and when locked

title: Quick reply save answer matched by the session-wide error, not by the request held in TextSave::Sending
trigger: Add a message to a shortcut while an unrelated quick-reply error (failed delete, failed shortcuts load) is showing; or the save request is dropped with the connection.
effect: settle_quick_reply_save reads `settings.quick_replies.error.is_some()` for 'refused': a save that succeeded puts its text back in the field (resubmit duplicates the message); a request that left flight with no answer counts as accepted and the text is lost. The RequestId in TextSave::Sending is only checked for 'still in flight'.
fix: Answer keyed by the RequestId in the stage (an Answered/Refused(reason) outcome per request, like SaveWatch), not a shared error slot; pane.error and session error folded into one

title: ShowStage::Saving(RequestId) never compares its request; the box settles on the privacy key's state
trigger: Tap Show My Last Seen while another save of the Last seen rule (or an older SaveFailed) is in the key state.
effect: drain_show_or_premium matches `Saving(_)` and then reads `settings.privacy[ShowStatus]` / `read_date`: an unrelated save's refusal toasts 'failed' for this request, and Ready from an older answer toasts 'shown' before this request is answered. The id held in the stage is dead data.
fix: Settle on the RequestId in the stage (answer/error for that request), as profile saves do with SaveWatch

title: DeleteStep is a two-variant Idle/Asked confirm that survives other actions; the delete itself has no stage
trigger: Open a shortcut with messages, press Delete (label turns into 'Delete with all messages'), then add or edit a message and press the same button.
effect: ShortcutPane::delete stays Asked until quick_replies_go replaces the pane, so any later press deletes the shortcut; the delete request is fire-and-forget and the dialog goes to the list whether or not TDLib refuses.
fix: One pane stage enum (Editing/ConfirmDelete/Deleting{request}) cleared by every other action

title: ProxyUi::notice is a one-shot slot that only fetch_proxy_list clears
trigger: Copy a proxy link ('copied' notice), then enable, delete or ping proxies on the same page without reopening it.
effect: The notice line stays under the list through unrelated actions and is overwritten by seven sites (mod.rs:399,441,444,468,499,600; proxy_row.rs:194); only fetch_proxy_list (opening the list) sets it None.
fix: A Toast/StatusNote with its own expiry, or a notice stage cleared on the next action

title: delete_proxy_entry flips use_system and persists prefs before the removal is sent
trigger: Delete the enabled proxy while the connection to TDLib is down (removeProxy fails to send).
effect: prefs.use_system = true and save_proxy_prefs run first; remove_proxy's Err is dropped by `let _`, so the saved preference no longer matches the proxy that is still enabled and no error shows.
fix: Set the fallback in the answer to the removal (keyed by its RequestId), or undo it when the send fails

title: The link box's stage (link_check) and the auto-switch rotation are reset by hand from UI code
trigger: Open a tg://proxy link, press Check, cancel, open another link; or change the auto-switch seconds while a rotation is running.
effect: link_check is set to Review/Warn from handle_proxy_link, close_proxy_link, reset_link_check, connect_link_proxy and check_link_proxy (UI), while the box value lives in ProxyUi::link and the answer is matched by Checking(request); set_proxy_auto_switch writes Rotation::Watching from the UI. A stage reset from outside its own transitions.
fix: Fold ProxyLinkBox and link_check into one stage owned in one place (Review/Warn/Checking{request}/Done), and let the rotation reset itself on a prefs change

title: ProxyUi::list_box bool is kept in step with pane_mode by a per-frame sync
trigger: Open Proxy settings from the sign-in screen, let the account reach Ready.
effect: list_box is a bool whose truth is `list_box && pane_mode()==Connecting`; sync_proxy_list_box clears it by hand each frame, and open_proxy_list sets it and opens the DialogKind separately.
fix: Derive the box from pane_mode (a PaneMode::Connecting overlay stage) or hold it in the sign-in screen's own state

title: dismiss_password_check ignores a failed send, resets the card by hand and leaves the suggestion
trigger: Press Dismiss or Done on the password check card while TDLib cannot take the request.
effect: hide_check_password_suggestion's Err is dropped (`let _`); the UI then writes password_check = Idle straight into the session, but check_password_suggested is only cleared on a successful send, so the card stays and nothing is said.
fix: Let the driver own the reset (set Idle only when the send went out) and show the error

title: Edit-profile errors live in a shared session slot cleared by hand at eight call sites, beside the dialog's own Submit::Failed
trigger: Fail a username change, then press Check or Save without reopening; fail a photo set, then change a name.
effect: users_state.profile_edit_error is set to None by hand in open_edit_profile_dialog, check_profile_username, submit_profile_username, move_profile_username, toggle_profile_username, remove_profile_photo, save_profile_form and send_profile_photo; the dialog shows `error.or(refused)` from two holders (profile_edit_error and dialog.save Failed). One operation's error can be shown for another.
fix: One per-operation stage (Submit per section keyed by RequestId) in the dialog; the session keeps no error slot

title: open_profile_dialog and open_birthday_privacy replace a Saving box without forgetting its request
trigger: Edit contact, press Save (box waits), then click Set / Suggest photo in the same box, or in the Birthday box click 'Choose who can see your birthday' while Saving.
effect: dialogs.profile_dialog is overwritten (open_profile_dialog:43, open_birthday_privacy:164) while ProfileDialog::Saving or ContactSave::Saving holds a request: forget_profile_saving is skipped, the saved toast and a refusal are lost, and an EditContact answer stays in dialog_answers (bounded). The body of a Saving box still has live rows. Two stage mechanisms (ProfileDialog::Saving and ContactSave::Saving) do the same job.
fix: One saving stage for every profile box, and replacing a box goes through close_profile_dialog; disable the body while Saving

title: ModalFade::Closing names a 110 ms close timer that is detach()ed and matched by target
trigger: Open a profile modal, close it, reopen the same profile within 110 ms and close it again.
effect: The close spawns a detached spawn_screen timer; the stage holds no Task, and the timer does take_if(is_closing && same target), so the first timer ends the second fade early (and a modal reopened and closing again loses its fade).
fix: Hold the timer Task in ModalFade::Closing (dropped on replace) instead of detaching it

title: PhotoSources keeps mode, camera stage, emoji editor, note and serial in step by hand; camera tasks are detached and matched by serial
trigger: Open the camera panel, lock the app; open the emoji editor, then lock.
effect: close_photo_source and close_cameras_for_lock each reset mode, camera, serial (and note/editor in one of them) by hand; CameraStage::Starting and Saving hold no task (start_camera / take_camera_photo spawn detach()ed tasks and compare photo_target + serial). The lock path leaves the emoji editor and note as they were.
fix: One PhotoSources stage enum (Closed/Emoji{..}/Camera(CameraStage)) with the task held in Starting/Saving and one close()

title: GradientEditor::hsl duplicates colors[selected] and is synced by hand
trigger: Edit a color by hex, then move a slider; select another swatch.
effect: hsl is written in editor_sync_controls and editor_slider_moved while colors/selected are written in four other places; if one path misses it the sliders and the swatch disagree.
fix: Derive hsl from colors[selected] when drawn, with the slider drag value as the only extra

title: SLIDE is a process-wide thread_local one-shot slot keyed by a bare ChatId
trigger: Pull to the next channel, then switch account or window within 480 ms.
effect: SLIDE holds (ChatId, topic, Instant) for the whole process, not per account or window: a private chat id is the user id, so the same id on another account (or the other main window) can slide in; it is cleared only when a render finds it shown or expired.
fix: A field on the history view (Option<Slide> in PullUi), owned and replaced with it

title: PullMachine's jumping stage, Route::Jumping and PullUi::window are set and cleared by hand in step
trigger: Release a ready pull, close the chat window or lock before the jump ends.
effect: pull_release begins machine.begin_jump and then sets route = Jumping (two places), pull_jump_ended and pull_sync reset machine and route separately; the window handle is never cleared, so if cx.update_window fails (window closed) the task ends without pull_jump_ended and machine.jumping() holds the indicator full.
fix: One jump stage (Pulling/Jumping{next,window,task}) whose Drop or end leaves the machine

title: start_personal_photo matches the box under the file picker by mem::discriminant, not by the box
trigger: Press Set photo in Edit contact, and while the picker is open (non-modal portal) open Edit contact of another person.
effect: `under` and `now` are discriminants of ProfileDialog: any EditContact matches any other, so the confirm opens over a different box than the one that asked.
fix: Compare the box's owner key (user_id) or a request token held in the stage

title: A user's pending gallery has no end when its fetch is dropped without an answer
trigger: Click a user's avatar when the profile photos request is lost (connection reset).
effect: pump_profile_gallery ends a pending Chat gallery on chat_photo_request_ended but a User gallery only on ProfilePhotosFetch::Failed, so a dropped request leaves pending_profile_gallery set with no note until the user navigates; a late arrival then opens the viewer over whatever is still on screen.
fix: Carry the fetch's RequestId in PendingGallery and end it when that request leaves flight

title: edit_exception / edit_exception_chat close the picker even when the edit was ignored
trigger: Add a user to an exception list while the rule is Loading or Failed (not Ready).
effect: mutate_privacy_detail returns silently without a Ready detail, but `if add { close_exception_picker() }` runs anyway, so the picker closes and nothing is saved or said.
fix: Close the picker from the save's own outcome (mutate returns whether it sent)

title: Send stops the record preview only after taking the capture, so the preview keeps playing
trigger: Pause a voice recording, press the preview Play, then press Send (also the story-reply Send, story_viewer/reply_media.rs:521)
effect: The preview audio keeps playing to its end after the message is sent; nothing ends it because the preview clock went with the capture and check_record_preview no longer sees it
fix: stop_record_preview must run before take_voice, or take_voice returns the preview so the caller stops the player

title: PermissionAsk stays Asking when the asking window closes before the prompt is answered
trigger: On macOS press record in a chat window while the camera or microphone prompt is up, close that chat window; the scoped task's update returns Gone and never sets Idle
effect: Later presses that still find the device undetermined return silently at the Asking check until restart; the answer of the ask is never read
fix: Reset PermissionAsk in the window's closing path (or hold the wait Task in the Asking variant so dropping it ends the ask)

title: PermissionAsk Idle/Asking is a two-variant stage kept beside CaptureStart for one press
trigger: Record press that needs a device prompt: PermissionAsk::Asking, then CaptureStart::Opening, then capture
effect: Two enums and a hand-run continuation (capture_access.rs) describe one start; each is reset by its own call sites
fix: One start stage enum: Idle, Asking{id,call,task}, Opening{start,..}

title: SchedulePicker::send_after and send_effect change together
trigger: Open the picker from the Schedule shortcut or the Send with Effect card
effect: send_effect is only meaningful when send_after is set, and both are written together by the caller; a picker opened any other way carries a bool and an effect that mean nothing
fix: enum OnConfirm { Keep, SendNow { effect: i64 } }

title: ChatUi::scheduled_dialog_open bool is swapped with schedule_picker by hand
trigger: Scheduled list, Reschedule (dialog flag cleared, picker opened, dialog closed), then Cancel the picker (close_schedule_picker reopens the list)
effect: Two boxes of one flow are a bool plus an Option kept in step at six call sites (lines 571, 703, 795, 806, 293-300); a missed site leaves both or neither open
fix: One enum ScheduleFlow { Closed, List, Picking(SchedulePicker) } on ChatUi

title: OpenChooser::window Option is the stage 'window being made'
trigger: Press Share Screen: Chooser::Open{window: None} until cx.defer opens the window, then Some
effect: open_screen_chooser comments 'without a window yet, it is being made'; screen_chooser_closed while None relies on the open_mut() None arm to remove the new window; the stage is an Option, not a variant
fix: Chooser::Opening{..} vs Chooser::Open{window,..}

title: demo_active and demo_active_audio are two fields written together
trigger: Demo/test accept or stop of a share (screen_chooser.rs:529, 548)
effect: The audio flag is only valid while demo_active is Some; stop clears both by hand
fix: Option<DemoShare { source, with_audio }>

title: The chat search field's text means a message query or a member filter depending on from_picker, and is cleared by hand at call sites
trigger: Open the From: picker, type a name, then change chat (session closes the chat search) or close the picker another way
effect: The field keeps the member filter text; open_chat_search_ui clears it only when 'fresh', chat_search_pick_sender and toggle_chat_search_picker clear it by hand, other closers do not
fix: Own the field's mode in the chat-search stage (Query | PickingSender) and clear text on its transitions

title: Global search debounce names a token while its timer Task is detached
trigger: Type in the global search field
effect: The debounce stage lives in the driver (Debounced{token}); the UI timer is spawn_screen(...).detach() matched by token only, so the Task is not held by the stage and cannot be cancelled by it
fix: Hold the commit Task in the debounce stage (dropped on query change, close, account switch)

title: In-chat search debounce names a token while its timer Task is detached
trigger: Type in the Search in chat field
effect: Same as the global one: ChatSearchQueryOutcome::Debounced{token} with a detached timer matched by token
fix: Hold the commit Task in the chat-search stage

title: PasteNotice::Showing names a 9 s timer whose Task is detached
trigger: Paste markdown into the composer, then close the window or switch chat before 9 s
effect: The Showing stage is matched by its own `at`, but the timer Task is .detach()ed outside the stage; if the window closes the task is dropped and Showing stays until the next field change
fix: Showing { at, field, timer: Task<()> }

title: refresh_sessions resets Fetch and sessions_op by hand from the page
trigger: Devices page, press Refresh while the list is loading or a terminate is in flight
effect: Writes Fetch::Idle straight into the session (blanking the list to 'No session data yet') and calls sessions_op.refetched(); maybe_fetch bails while a GetActiveSessions request is in flight, so the list stays blank until that answer, and a failed answer leaves it empty
fix: A driver method that marks the list Stale (keeping data) and refetches, instead of dropping the Fetch

title: wanted_reactor_tab is a one-shot slot reset by hand when a message menu opens
trigger: Open a chip's menu that asks a reactor tab, close it before the properties arrive, open another menu
effect: The slot (session.messages.wanted_reactor_tab) is cleared from open_message_menu and taken in connect/message_menu.rs; nothing else clears it (chat or account change keeps it until the next menu)
fix: Store the wanted tab in the open menu (OpenMenu) so it dies with the menu

title: Quote picker (ChatUi reply bar) and reply chooser (ShareStage::ReplyChooser) are mutually exclusive by hand
trigger: Reply options: Update Quote then Reply in Another Chat, or the reverse
effect: open_reply_elsewhere closes the quote picker, apply_reply_option(UpdateQuote) closes the chooser, close_reply_panels closes both; two owners (ChatUi and share) coordinated at call sites
fix: One ReplyPanel enum on the reply bar: None | QuotePicker | Chooser

title: RequestShare kind and stage are two values with invalid pairs
trigger: Location request opened while the agent guard refuses the lookup (locate_for_request returns early), or a Phone request
effect: Phone lives in Picking forever; Location in Picking shows 'Locating' with the confirm disabled and no retry; Locating/Located only make sense for Location and Picking/Confirm only for Users/Chat
fix: Fold into one enum per kind: Phone, Location(LocateStage), Users(Pick), Chat(Pick)

title: Round video seek ends only through a mouse-up handler registered while the overlay paints
trigger: Drag the seek ring of a paused round video, scroll it out of view or change chat before releasing the button
effect: Audio::Seeking{was_playing} stays set and the player stays paused; the end_seek handler exists only for frames that paint this overlay
fix: End a seek from a window-level mouse-up owned by the stage, or drop Seeking when the overlay unmounts

title: assert! in the ready-search-in-chat demo seeder
trigger: Demo capture of search in chat when the demo session has no open chat
effect: apply_ready_search_in_chat panics on assert!(session.open_chat_search()) in non-test code
fix: Return early when open_chat_search is false

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut of RecordingUi::round_preview in render
trigger: Render of the round record overlay while end_capture_flags or another borrower holds the cell
effect: borrow_mut can panic if the cell is held; end_capture_flags uses try_borrow_mut and silently skips end() so the old image would leak into the next recording
fix: Make RoundPreview a plain field with &mut access, owned by the Capture

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut on RichPreview::parsed with a nested borrow_mut of RichDraftUi::parsed
trigger: Render of the rich editor preview
effect: parsed.borrow_mut() is held while editor.borrow_mut().parse() runs; a re-entrant call would panic
fix: Hold the parse state as plain fields on RichDraftUi, updated by &mut self
